en.headline: FLOCKFEST craft beer and indie music festival ends Sunday at PMQ
en.dek: Black Kite Brewery’s three-day event at the Central courtyard wraps up this afternoon with Japanese and local brews, live sets and food stalls.
body: The final day of FLOCKFEST 2026 runs from noon to 5pm on Sunday at the Courtyard and Marketplace of PMQ in Central, organised by Black Kite Brewery.

Eight breweries from Hong Kong and Japan are pouring more than 50 beers across 20 taps, including eight limited collaboration releases. Local food vendors and live performances by Hong Kong indie acts complete the programme.
Admission is free. Drinks and merchandise are sold separately. The venue is at 35 Aberdeen Street; the nearest MTR exit is Sheung Wan A2.

zh.headline: FLOCKFEST手工啤酒音樂節周日於元創方完結
zh.dek: 黑鳶啤酒主辦的三日活動今日中午至下午5時在中環PMQ廣場收官，有日港酒廠啤酒、本地獨立音樂及美食攤位。
body: FLOCKFEST 2026最後一日於周日中午12時至下午5時在中環元創方地面廣場及市集舉行，由黑鳶啤酒主辦。
現場有八間香港及日本酒廠，透過20個水龍頭提供超過50款啤酒，當中包括八款活動限定聯乘產品。另有本地美食攤位及多組香港獨立音樂單位演出。
入場免費，飲品及周邊商品另行收費。地址為鴨巴甸街35號，港鐵上環站A2出口步行可達。
